mapper.insert: insert into agent_idempotency_record (id, token_id, tool_name, request_id, request_hash, response_json, create_time, status, hash_version, completed_time, identity_version) values (#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tokenId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toolName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{responseJson,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'SUCCEEDED', coalesce(#{hashVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'legacy-v0'), #{createTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'binary-v2')
mapper.delete: update agent_idempotency_record set response_json=NULL,status='EXPIRED' where create_time < #{expiresBefore} AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND hash_version IN ('legacy-v0','generic-canonical-v1')
